items: Two more popular shooters in the preset library (Pro)
Mirroring from a computer (e.g. scrcpy)? Press any letter key in Wasdo to have your keyboard recognized
In-game tips: press Esc for camera mode, and lower sensitivity if the camera turns too fast
Floating pill and key overlay stay hidden while mapping is off
Fixed occasional crashes when closing in-game panels

Play touch-only Android games with a USB or Bluetooth keyboard and mouse: WASD to move, mouse look to turn the camera, keys and mouse buttons for skills, plus cursor and typing modes. Start from the FPS or MOBA template and fine-tune keys in the drag-and-drop editor. One accessibility permission, no root, no ADB, no PC. Not working on your device or game? Tell us from Settings.

Wasdo's first early access release. Play touch-only Android games with a USB or Bluetooth keyboard and mouse: WASD to move, the mouse to aim and turn the camera, keys for skills. No root, no ADB. Not working with your device or game? Send us feedback from Settings, it really helps.
